description: A web-based todo list application that lets users securely sign up, create tasks, organize them into custom categories, and view tasks filtered by category.
target_users: Individuals looking for a simple personal productivity tool
Small teams that need a lightweight shared task manager
core_features: User registration, login, and JWT based authentication
Filter and view tasks by selected category
future_features: Email or push notifications for upcoming due dates
Share tasks or categories with other users
Offline support with local sync when back online

milestones: Set up repository and CI pipeline
Design database schema and implement models
Build authentication endpoints and JWT handling
Create CRUD APIs for tasks and categories
Develop core UI pages for login, registration, and dashboard
Add task filtering by category on the dashboard
Implement due date handling and UI display
Improve UI/UX with responsive design and error handling
Write unit and integration tests for all services
Integrate email/push notification service for reminders
Enable task sharing between users with permission controls
Add offline storage and sync mechanism using Service Workers
